results.name: Mister Chill
results.description:
I made this model back in 2011, after being inspired by the look of the characters in The Adventures of Tintin (2011). It was my first attempt at using 3DS Max's Particle Flow to help create a character's hair.

I have updated this project to utilize Sketchfab's new subsurface scattering material options.

results.name: 12671 Vase Stand - Modenese Gastone
results.description:
Photorealistic and high quality detailed 3d models. Good quality, every detail is excellent for close-up renders.

The model is based on the company manufacturers original dimensions and technical data.

Excellent for interior renderings.

The files are 3ds Max 2011, obj, fbx.

All textures and materials are included and setted.

The 3ds Max 2011 version is optimized for V-Ray.

Real-world scale (Millimeters).

Please see more on profile dowloads.

results.name: 2011 Chevrolet Cruze Police
results.description:
Desc. and Motif:

This is 2011 Police Chevrolet Cruze version lowpoly 3d models fully maped and textured in 3ds max 2009. Texture res is 1024x1024 per car and made from photos.
Setuped for 3ds max 2008+V-ray version you can see as main product.
3ds max8 format with standard materials included
Made for use in games, real-time rendering soft, Numerous copying, perfect for arch.rendering.
